selectionPolicy: Complete enumeration of every parsed question in each of the twenty official en-10k training files; no sampling and no omitted valid row.
executionPartitioning: The evaluator processes one source task file and its 10,000 questions at a time, releases per-case successes after witness validation, and retains aggregate counts plus bounded failure evidence. The complete immutable archive remains frozen in the ignored source cache.
testEvidence: Official test files were not opened, parsed, scored, sampled, or used for diagnosis in this cycle.
oracleIsolation: Answers are joined only inside the host scorer after label-free typed tasks have executed. Support-line annotations are not supplied to the compiler or reasoner.
